subject: Handing off multi-team API + Console enable — facilitator rotation & quiet window
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearwave.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: lori.procurement@clearwave.com
Date: 2025-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff / enable week — availability and request

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the notes from today's discovery. We want to lock in the hands-on enable next week but have a couple constraints: several engineers are EMEA-based (mostly GMT+1) and a few product folks are only available after 17:00 CET.

Can we split the session into a 90-minute API deep-dive (morning CET) and a 60-minute Console + runbook runthrough (late afternoon CET) so both groups get the right exposure? Also, we'll need a quiet window for our sandbox so we can run end-to-end tests without interference — is a 2 hour block feasible?

Lastly, Lori from procurement asked whether we can share the session roster and the SSO setup screenshot before the enable.

—Samir

[attachment: session_roster_clearwave.csv]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearwave.com>; lori.procurement@clearwave.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-15T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff / enable week — availability and request

Thanks Samir — that split makes sense and mirrors what we've done for similar clients. Proposed plan:

- Day 1 (Nov 24) 09:00-10:30 CET: API deep-dive, sample calls, token best-practices (Ben lead)
- Day 1 (Nov 24) 16:30-17:30 CET: Console walkthrough + runbook handoff (Vanessa lead, Connor backup)
- Sandbox quiet window: Nov 24 17:30-19:30 CET (2 hours) for ClearWave tests

To confirm I'll need: final attendee list (names + roles), and confirmation that SSO test client is provisioned for the sandbox account. I've attached the latest runbook and a small SSO screenshot to show the property we need set.

If Lori wants procurement-facing artifacts I can also produce a one-pager showing who has access and retention settings.

Thanks,
Vanessa

[attachment: redwood_runbook_v2.pdf][attachment: sso-client-setup.png]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-17T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff / enable week — availability and request

Vanessa / Connor — quick note on facilitator rotation and backup coverage. If we schedule the API deep-dive for the morning CET slot, I'll lead live coding and pass off to Connor for the Console session. Connor, can you confirm you have the demo tokens for the sandbox and the Jupyter examples?

Also proposing a 30-minute preflight on Nov 23 at 14:00 CET to validate SSO, tokens, and that the quiet window can be applied to the sandbox cluster. I'll add a checklist to the runbook:
- Verify SSO client present and test users provisioned
- Confirm sandbox scaling fixed for quiet window (no autoscale)
- Pre-populate sample dataset for rate-limited tests

Thanks — Ben

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearwave.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-18T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff / enable week — availability and request

Samir / Lori — quick follow-up after Ben's checklist: I confirmed with infra that we can reserve the sandbox quiet window Nov 24 17:30-19:30 CET and that autoscaling will be disabled for that 2-hour block. I also uploaded the demo tokens and a pre-populated sample dataset under the ClearWave sandbox account.

Next steps for your team:
- Final attendee roster by EOD Nov 19 (so we can set role-level UI permissions)
- Confirm SSO test user emails (we created test users matching the roster)
- Approve the preflight time: Nov 23 14:00 CET (30 minutes) — I'll send calendar invites once Lori confirms procurement is okay with the window.

If Lori needs a procurement summary I can strip the technical bits and send a short permissions/retention doc for review.

Thanks,
Connor
